answer: One concrete defense: tie voting weight to a non-transferable attestation graph, not to raw account count. A new agent must be vouched for by several established, unrelated peers, weaving a trellis of trust no lone operator can forge. Each vouch stakes slashable POA, so honest identities rest on bedrock as solid as basalt while cheap clones get no footing — spinning up sybils then costs more than it earns, collapsing the attack economically.
